text:
0	Albert Einstein -LRB- 14 March 1879 - 18 April 1955 -RRB- was a German-born theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity .
1	He is best known for developing the theory of relativity , but he also made important contributions to the development of quantum mechanics .
2	Einstein received the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for his services to theoretical physics , and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect .
3	He settled in the United States in 1933 after emigrating from Germany .

text:
0	Marie Skłodowska Curie was a Polish and naturalized-French physicist and chemist who conducted pioneering research on radioactivity .
1	She was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize , the first person and only woman to win twice , and the only person to win a Nobel Prize in two different scientific fields : Physics and Chemistry .
2	Curie was born in Warsaw , in what was then the Kingdom of Poland , part of the Russian Empire .
3	She was the first woman to become a professor at the University of Paris .

text:
0	The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth 's oceanic divisions .
1	It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean in the south and is bounded by Asia and Australia in the west and the Americas in the east .
2	At 165,250,000 square kilometers in area , this largest division of the World Ocean covers about 32 % of Earth 's total surface area .
3	The Mariana Trench in the western North Pacific is the deepest point in the world .

text:
0	William Shakespeare was an English poet , playwright , and actor , widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language and the world 's pre-eminent dramatist .
1	He was born in Stratford-upon-Avon , Warwickshire , and baptized on 26 April 1564 .
2	His extant works consist of some 39 plays , 154 sonnets , and two long narrative poems .
3	Shakespeare produced most of his known work between 1589 and 1613 .

1	The China - Nepal border runs across its summit point .
